name: Family Visit Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a request letter from a 'responsible person' in the DRC clearly stating the visit's purpose, plus that sponsor's identity documentation (passport bio page, national ID, or DRC visa with passport copy). The specific family relationships that qualify are not defined by name in the source reviewed -- it refers broadly to 'visiting family or friends' rather than a distinct family-only category.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain a sponsor letter and identity documentation from the person being visited in DRC.

sources.title: Congo eVisa (private visa-assistance site) -- family visit eVisa requirements, 7-day stay, 90-day visa validity, and processing timelines

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Democratic Republic of the Congo). STATUS: DRAFT -- weakest-defined route in this build. This is a short-stay VISIT visa, not a residence-granting family reunification/settlement route -- no source located in this build describes a longer-term family-based residence permit for spouses/dependents of DRC residents or citizens (distinct from, and much thinner than, the family reunification routes built for most other countries in this dataset). Modeled here for schema completeness with heavy caveats rather than omitted, since it is the only family-category mechanism found. A genuine longer-term family/spousal residence route may exist under DRC's general immigration law but was not located in this build.
